name: Chou no Doku Hana no Kusari ~Gensou Yawa~
original_name: 蝶の毒 華の鎖 ～幻想夜話～
source:
The fandisc of the game,  "Chou no Doku Hana no Kusari" (released on May 2011). The fandisc adds onto what happened after the events of the happy endings as well as expanding on popular bad ends. There are lots of small bonuses, like a cult quiz, "Chou Doku Questions and Answers Notebook", and "Kyouko's Fortune Telling Hut". 

[Translated from the [URL=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=752234&gc=gc]Getchu.com product page[/URL].]
translation:
《蝶之毒 华之锁》的Fan Disc，原作于2011年5月发售。本作补充了各条幸福结局之后发生的故事，也扩展了人气较高的悲剧结局。另有大量小型附赠内容，例如狂热问答《蝶毒问答手册》和《镜子的占卜小屋》。

[译自[URL=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=752234&gc=gc]Getchu.com商品页面[/URL]。]
